source_grid.score: alphabet-size-normalized whole-section index of coincidence; source prints top three per stream/section
source_grid.sequence_eligibility: source len(seq)>400, then len(seq)>=stream_length+200; preserve source's 500-element prime-index sequence and duplicate names
source_grid.solved_running_key: LP solved plaintext GP indices mod28, first 400 chain increments of each unsolved section, both signs, all offsets 0..len(K)-n-1

preoutcome_controls.positive: Generate 1200 GP29 plaintext symbols from a fixed English-like solved-source segment, add a source prime key at offset 47 in raw Z29, and independently construct a chain-Z28 source-prime-key ciphertext; require their planted rule to exceed a matched whole-grid shuffle 95th percentile, not exact key identity where equivalent keys tie.
preoutcome_controls.null: For each of nine unsolved source sections, shuffle raw rune order 99 times with fixed random.Random(330104), reconstruct each stream, scan the complete eligible sequence/offset/sign grid, and retain the maximum score; plus-one selected-grid tail. If this full control exceeds the runtime gate, retain the source replay as descriptive and disclose the unavailable control rather than using a partial null as a full-grid p-value.
preoutcome_controls.runtime_gate: Benchmark one 729-rune synthetic source-length section and one shuffle before LP2 scoring; full nine-section source grid plus controls should complete in about ten minutes or less on the local host.

claim_limit: Replay source settings and measure selected maxima only; no broad arithmetic-key or chain-cipher exclusion without a sufficiently powered positive gate and matched controls.
